label: Discover run over modal sense-fork nodes: frame strength orders registered, rest triaged
summary: The discovery command truth-discover (24 explicit targets on the modal sense-fork nodes, premise pool all, 10 candidates; main e61946aa1, report 20261120T134013Z) gave 7 kernel-checked discoveries, 2 inconsistent cores and 12 unresolved targets. Registered: the frame-class strength orders S5 > S4, S5 > KTB, S4 > KT and KTB > KT among the route's open frame premises (OnticFrameS5/S4/KTB/KT), each a single-premise result applying the modal library (s5_implies_s4, s5_implies_ktb of TruthCore.Modal.Cube; conjunct projection for S4 > KT and KTB > KT), with one shared strictness control (reflexive non-transitive chain: KT not S4; two-world order frame: KT not KTB, S4 not S5; reflexive symmetric non-transitive path: KTB not S5), and strong_version_needed on the three frame-class branch arguments. Not registered, with reasons: (1) t16 (KTB and S4 frame give S5 frame, proof via symmetric_transitive_implies_euclidean of TruthCore.Modal.Kripke; compiled locally) is deferred for the PR file limit only; with the two S5 registrations it shows that the S5 frame premise says exactly what KTB and S4 say jointly. The corpus records this equivalence only at node level (S5 node iff S4 node and a symmetric frame, and KTB node iff T node and a symmetric frame, specs/strength-necessary-frames.toml), not for the frame premises. (2) t3 and t6: NecessaryPredecessorLifting entails NoNovelNecessarySupport (third conjunct, extra necessity hypothesis unused) and NoContingentGroundOfNecessary (first conjunct). Neither is a transcription, and neither is recorded: only the converse direction lifting_of_two_bridges (with ActualReflexive) exists. Together they show that under actual reflexivity lifting is equivalent to the two bridges. They are strength orders (lifting is the strong version), deferred for the file limit. Strictness outlines, not yet Lean-checked: a necessary target supported at a non-actual world by a contingent source satisfies NoNovel vacuously and fails lifting; two necessary individuals with a support edge only at a non-actual world satisfy NoContingent and fail lifting. (3) t21, t22 (t23 duplicate): any two distinct reading pins IntendedIsBoxT, IntendedIsBoxS4, IntendedIsBoxB, IntendedIsBoxS5 are jointly inconsistent by construction: each fixes Intended to one constructor of the Sense enumeration, so two pins force two distinct constructors to be equal. The exclusion uses no frame class or modal content. It is not recorded as alternative_to, because the pins are coexisting conditional reading choices, each the premise of its own fork route, not rival premises whose refutation is needed (modal-sense-support.toml). (4) t24: NecessaryRootOnIntendedReading entails NecessarySenseUnique. The witness filter of the run is settled: the premise holds in the checked one-point model of MODAL-FORK-CONTROLS (Nonvacuity, Intended = boxT). It is not registered: uniqueness is literally a conjunct of the node's definition, so the step is a definitional projection. Every route to the node either takes NecessarySenseUnique as a premise (forkOnIntendedReading, a closed cycle) or takes an IntendedIsBox pin, which gives uniqueness directly, so it adds no discriminating information. Unresolved (no proof found, not refuted): t1 ActualReflexive, t2 Euclidean, t5 WellFoundedPresentEsseSupport, t7 to t11 LogicalNecessityProfiles targets, t13 NecessaryRootBoxS5, t18 to t20 the T, 5 and B schema validity premises. t4 and t12 were filtered as domain_by_name (identification across modules by name only).
blocker: Next tests: register t16 and the two lifting strength orders, with a Lean-checked strictness control for each and strong_version_needed on the three arguments that use lifting. Certify a difference for each of the four new frame registrations (delta symmetric frame for S5/S4 and KTB/KT, delta transitive frame for S5/KTB and S4/KT). Attempt the frame-to-schema bridges (OnticFrameKT gives OnticTSchemaValid by axiomT_valid, and so on) that the run left unresolved (t18 to t20). Every frame premise stays open.
